author: KEXP
description: With ripping guitars and ferocious vocals, Cardiff outfit Panic Shack offer a vibrant set of indie punk in our latest in-studio session. Live on KEXP with Sonic Reducer host Brian Foss, the band share a performance of "Pockets" and more.
title: Panic Shack performs "Pockets" & more Live on KEXP
